BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to oil spills; creating a new section; andproviding an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Consistent with RCW 43.01.036, thedepartment of ecology must submit a report to the appropriate standingcommittees of the senate and house of representatives by September 1,2012, that includes: A summary of and update on actions taken toimplement chapter 122, Laws of 2011, which dealt with oil spills andthe state's oil spill program; and legislative recommendations, if any. (2) This section expires December 31, 2012.
